response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM execution_counts), scored AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average_share FROM shares) SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share_minus_average_share FROM scored ORDER BY share_minus_average_share IS NULL, share_minus_average_share DESC, order_reference IS NULL, order_reference LIMIT 10;
